dns.title: DNS setup
dns.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the DNS instructions for this server.
dns.active: Your domain is verified and routed through the Gateway. Capacity measurement runs in the background and the numbers will appear on the server card shortly.

step1.title: Prove domain ownership
step1.text: Add this TXT record in your DNS provider, wait for it to propagate, then click “Verify ownership”. Keep it in place after verification.

step2.title: Route your domain to the Gateway

dns.noRouting: Gateway routing isn’t configured on the platform yet, so there are no routing records to show. Please contact support.
dns.routingMulti: Choose ONE of the options below (not both). Use CNAME for subdomains and A for root domains.
dns.routingSingle: Add this record, then click “Verify routing”.
dns.cooldown: Too many checks. You can verify again in {{s}}s.
dns.ownerOnly: Only Owners and Admins can run verification.

delete.title: Delete server
delete.description: This stops protection for the domain and permanently deletes its security events.
delete.warning: If your DNS still points to the Gateway, visitors will stop reaching your site after deletion. Point the domain back to your origin server (or remove the Gateway records) as part of this change.

form.addDesc: Traffic for this domain will pass through the Zero Plus Gateway.
form.editDesc: Changing the domain requires verifying DNS ownership again.

domain.label: Domain
domain.hint: e.g. shop.example.com — no http:// and no port

form.tip: Tip: start with Monitor only to review decisions, then switch to Protect.

https.title: Origin uses HTTPS
https.hint: Turn off if the origin only speaks plain HTTP.

notice.domain: A new verification token will be issued and DNS ownership must be verified again before protection works for the new domain.
notice.origin: Changing the origin resets reachability, response times and capacity numbers. Capacity is measured again for the new origin.
notice.ssl: Changing the HTTPS setting triggers a new measurement.

toast.same: The values are the same as the current ones
toast.dnsResetDesc: Add the new TXT record and verify again.
toast.originResetDesc: Health and capacity numbers will be measured again.
toast.addedDesc: Follow the DNS steps to activate protection.

domain.noProtocol: Enter the domain only, without http:// or https://
domain.noPath: Enter the domain only (no paths, spaces or special characters)
domain.noPathOrPort: Enter the domain only (no path, port or spaces)
domain.needsExtension: Domain needs an extension, e.g. shop.example.com
domain.wildcard: Wildcard domains are not supported. Add each subdomain separately
domain.hasPort: Don’t include a port in the domain. Use the Port field

originIp.ipv6: IPv6 is not supported yet. Use an IPv4 address

originPort.reserved: This port is reserved for a non-web service and can’t be used as an origin
